title: Haryana Chirayu – Ayushman Bharat Haryana Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Haryana government health assurance expansion providing cashless hospitalization coverage to eligible families under the state/PM-JAY framework.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility is based on Haryana's currently notified household/category and beneficiary criteria.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Haryana Chirayu – Ayushman Bharat Haryana.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
